facts.text: Snow left Mount Crag (3,960 ft) and Waterhole (5,010 ft) 22 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 9 (2025)

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: May 27 (2023), May 30 (2024), June 1 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Mount Crag (3,960 ft) and Waterhole (5,010 ft).

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: 14.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 43.4 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: 18.8 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 33.8 in (2023), 24.6 in (2024), 35.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 8 and May 14, carried from the melt-out dates at Mount Crag (3,960 ft) and Waterhole (5,010 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 1,032 ft above the pass; points to March 22 to May 19

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 2,082 ft above the pass; points to February 23 to May 9
